cooldown.binNote: The bin's static cooldown field is 0 for all ranks; the wiki states the true cooldown is dynamic, equal to 1 divided by Zeri's attack speed (capped via AttackSpeedCap=1.5), not a flat per-rank value.

values.binNote: Derived by the wiki dividing the total-burst base/ratio (ZeriQ.BaseDamage, ZeriQ.ActiveADRatio) by NumberOfMissiles=7 (rounds); no separate bin row per-hit.

mechanics.claim: Burst Fire fires 7 rounds over the cast time, each a separate basic-attack damage instance to the first enemy hit.
mechanics.quote: fires a burst of {{#var:rounds}} rounds in the target direction over the cast time, each dealing {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit

mechanics.claim: Each round is treated as a basic attack: it deals basic damage, can critically strike, and applies on-hit and on-attack effects.
mechanics.quote: it hits any enemy unit a typical basic attack can; deals {{tip|basic damage}}; can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Zeri|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage; and applies {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects to the first enemy hit

mechanics.claim: Burst Fire's cooldown and cast time scale down with attack speed, capped at 1.5 attacks per second (only Overcharged bonus AS can exceed the cap).
mechanics.quote: ''Burst Fire's'' {{sti|cooldown}} and cast time are reduced with {{sti|{{as|attack speed}}}}, with the maximum of {{as|{{fd|1.5}}|attack speed}} attacks per second

mechanics.claim: 60% of attack speed in excess of the cap is converted into bonus attack damage.
mechanics.quote: {{#expr: {{#var:excess_as_to_ad_ratio}} * 100 }}% of {{as|attack speed}} in excess of the cap is converted into {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}

mechanics.claim: Burst Fire deals basic damage and does not trigger spell effects, but is tagged area of effect for targets after the first.
mechanics.quote: ''Burst Fire'' deals {{tip|basic damage}} and does not trigger {{tip|spell effects}}. It is additionally tagged as [[area of effect]] when damaging targets after the first.

mechanics.claim: Burst Fire does not trigger Spellblade despite counting as an ability activation for other on-cast effects.
mechanics.quote: It does '''not''' count as an ability activation for {{tip|Spellblade}}.

mechanics.claim: Casting Burst Fire does not cancel a previous attack order or movement.
mechanics.quote: Casting ''Burst Fire'' does not cancel previous attack ({{ai|Living Battery|Zeri}}) and movement orders.

mechanics.claim: Burst Fire has no mana cost.
